title: Apprentice – 432 Posts
qualification: Class XII pass with Skill Certificate in Domestic Data Entry Operator
age_limit: The minimum age for IOCL Barauni Apprentice 2026 is 18 years, and the maximum is 24 years as on 30 June 2026 for General/EWS candidates. Age relaxation is extended to SC, ST, OBC (NCL), and PwBD candidates as per Government of India guidelines — up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and up to 10 years for PwBD candidates irrespective of reservation. Only the Matriculation (Class X) certificate issued by the Board of Secondary Education is accepted as proof of age.
selection_process: Candidates wondering about the IOCL Barauni selection process can note that there is no written test for this apprentice engagement. Selection is based purely on the percentage of marks scored in the prescribed qualification, in descending order, among candidates registered on the NAPS/NATS portal.
